serviceIdentification.serviceName: Accenture Extended Detection and Response (XDR) for government
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Accenture Extended Detection and Response (XDR) for government
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Accenture Extended Detection and Response (XDR) for government service is a proactive security platform designed for Federal agencies and customers. This scalable threat monitoring service enables all Continental United States (CONUS) government entities trusted and reliable cyber defense at a fraction of the cost of traditional 24/7 in-house incident response programs. XDR provides security monitoring using real-time threat intel and Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) capabilities to decrease the mean time to resolution on all security incidents. XDR is built in the cloud to provide maximum availability and scalability.
